videos.desc: A cartoon man sits in a clinic waiting room holding his swollen cheek in pain; he presses a cold pack against his jaw, groans with a toothache, and winces even harder when he tries to sip his hot coffee.

A mother and her small son enter a health clinic, check in with the smiling receptionist at the desk, and wait on yellow chairs next to an old man with a cane until a doctor in a white coat opens the door and calls the boy in.
In a hospital corridor, a teenage boy with a grey medical boot on one foot walks on two metal crutches while nurses watch behind him; he gets faster and finishes with a happy little fist pump.

In a hand-painted anime scene, a shirtless climber in a green helmet collapses onto a grassy hillside after a fall, grimacing and clutching his shoulder. A worried woman kneels beside him, touching the hurt arm as he winces in pain and holds the joint.

In an animated old apothecary, a woman squeezes the bulb of a glass dropper, draws up liquid and counts three drops into a wooden spoon. She hands the dose to a red-bearded man wrapped in a blanket, who takes it and immediately looks better.
videos.said: One. Two. Steady. Three drops. That's enough. But better already.

videos.desc: An animated woman in a red tracksuit unwraps a bandage from her forearm, opens and closes her hand to test it, then happily reaches up to gymnastic rings and pumps her fist because the arm has healed.

In a Pixar-style park scene a jogger hobbles to a bench, pulls off his sock, and watches his hurt ankle balloon into a huge round lump; he gasps, pokes it, and presses a blue ice pack on the swelling.

A young woman sits on a couch with her feet up; one foot and ankle are visibly red and puffy compared to the other. A shocked man points at the swollen foot and presses an ice pack onto it while she winces.

A tearful young woman hugs a pillow in an armchair and talks to a grey-haired therapist who listens with a notebook. She cries, takes a tissue, gradually starts smiling, and leaves the session relieved, shaking the therapist's hand.

In a retro cartoon, a nurse shakes a glass thermometer and puts it in a sick man's mouth; the red line rockets up as his whole face glows red like a stoplight, so she dumps a bucket of ice on his head and the reading sinks back down.
videos.said: Open under the tongue. Ah. Oh, you are very hot. Broo-hoo, cold.

videos.desc: A curly-haired young man sits in a living room with a big fluffy ginger cat on his lap; as he strokes it his eyes go red and streaming and he sneezes into a paper tissue; a woman in denim lifts the cat off him and carries it across the room, and he keeps sneezing and wiping his nose while she holds the cat at a distance.

A red-haired man in a green tartan shirt stands on a grassy hillside path, screwing his face up and reaching one arm back over his shoulder to rub the top of his own back, then reaching round with the other hand to press the small of his back. The clip cuts to him walking up a fern-lined dirt track with a large black rucksack on, laughing, with two other walkers on the path behind. In the last shots he gives a red-haired woman in a mustard fleece a piggyback along the same path, both of them laughing at the camera with green bracken all around.

A grey-haired man in an apron is chopping vegetables in a rustic kitchen when he catches his finger with the knife. He winces, sucks the finger, then hurries to the sink and holds it under the running tap while the water runs pink. He dries it, tears open a small plaster and wraps it around the cut fingertip while a woman keeps cooking behind him.

High on a rocky mountain path with snow peaks behind her, a hiker with a big backpack limps to a rock and sits down, pulling off her boot. She rolls the sock down to show a raised, shiny blister on the back of her heel. Her companion crouches beside her, digs a plaster out of his pack and passes it to her; she peels it open and presses it carefully over the blister before easing the sock and boot back on.

A mother and her teenage son with a grey backpack walk up to a small pink and turquoise clinic with a blue cross sign over the door and go in. Inside they stop at a reception counter, where the boy presses a bell on the countertop. They then sit down on yellow plastic chairs against the wall. Beside them an elderly man waits with both hands on a walking stick; a low table in front of them holds magazines. Notices and certificates cover the wall and a round clock hangs above. A doctor in a white coat appears in the corridor doorway and they get up.

A woman in a mint green jumper holds a glass pipette full of golden yellow oil over a tall glass of water on a kitchen counter. She squeezes the bulb and small yellow beads fall one at a time from the tip into the water, where they hang and sink as little spheres. She keeps counting them out, and the oil spreads into yellow swirls through the glass. She screws the pipette back into its brown bottle, lifts the glass, and drinks the cloudy yellow water by the window.

In a clinic a doctor in a white coat stands at a lit X-ray viewer showing the bones of a hand and wrist. She points a pen at a thin dark line running across one of the bones. The young man beside her leans in and looks at the line on the film. He then sits back with his forearm in a thick white plaster cast held up in a blue sling, winces, and holds the casted arm against his chest.
videos.said: I'll show you this. Oh, I see.

videos.desc: A woman in a cream blouse sits at a desk in a busy open-plan office with a monitor, keyboard and paper coffee cup in front of her. She presses her fingertips against both temples and moves them in small circles, screwing up her face. She keeps pressing, moving her hands up over her forehead and into her hair, then lowers her head into her hands and finally lays her head down on her folded arms on the desk while colleagues work behind her.

A nurse in teal scrubs pushes a supply trolley down a bright hospital corridor while colleagues wave at her. At a bedside she holds a forehead thermometer to a middle-aged male patient's temple and reads it. She shakes out his pillow and slides it back behind his head, and he laughs. In close-up she winds a white bandage around his wrist above the drip line. Finally she holds up a small bottle of juice for him and he grins back at her.

In a bright clinic room a queue of young people wait their turn. A young man pulls his sleeve up and grins over his shoulder while a syringe goes into his upper arm, then shows the round plaster stuck on the spot; a young woman in a black top takes hers the same way and points at her plaster; a woman in glasses gets her injection next; at the end the whole group lines up facing the camera and taps the plasters on their bare arms.
videos.said: Tiny pitch. Done. Ow, not bad. Brave. Yay!

videos.desc: Gym-goers come out of a glass gym door in sportswear, walking stiff-legged and grimacing. A man in a grey T-shirt holds the door and winces as he steps down, and a blonde woman in leggings hobbles out after him. A woman with curly hair lowers herself onto a street bench with her face screwed up, then sits rubbing her legs. At the end the whole group waddles down the pavement together with straight, sore legs.
videos.said: Ooh, my legs. Leg day. Ow, ow.

videos.desc: A young blonde woman with a plaited ponytail stands on the open rear deck of a ferry, holding the handrail with the ship's white wake stretching away behind her across a cold blue sea. Her face is screwed up and she clamps both hands over her mouth, swallowing hard. She keeps her hands there, breathing through them, then gives up standing and sits down on the deck bench, doubled forward with both hands still pressed over her mouth while other passengers stand at the rail further back.

A team in blue scrubs, caps, masks and white gloves stands around a draped patient on an operating table under a large round surgical lamp. One of them leans over the opening in the drapes and works with instruments while the others hold retractors. A woman looks up at the camera as a scalpel is passed hand to hand over a metal tray; a heart monitor beside the table shows the pulse trace and the numbers 190, 20 and 99. The team keeps working around the table, then all of them look up at the camera and give a thumbs up.
